map.润滑油粘度选型：基于工况温度、载荷等级与转速，按润滑油牌号与粘度标准（如 ISO: Lubricating oil viscosity selection: based on duty temperature, load level and speed, by oil grade and viscosity standard (e.g. ISO VG) select a suitable viscosity grade, and check whether the actual viscosity at duty temperature is sufficient, for lubrication design.
map.💡 基准粘度随温度升高而增大；重载×1.3，轻载×0.8；高速降低粘度，低速增大: Tip: base viscosity grows with temperature; heavy load times 1.3, light load times 0.8; high speed lowers viscosity, low speed raises it; match the nearest ISO VG grade
map.粘度等级为40℃运动粘度中心值（cSt）: Viscosity grade is the kinematic viscosity center value at 40 °C (cSt)
map.实际选型还需考虑润滑方式和添加剂要求: Actual selection should also consider lubrication method and additive requirements
map.📚 深度解析：润滑油粘度选型（ISO VG 等级推荐）: In-depth: Lubricating Oil Viscosity Selection (ISO VG grade recommendation)
map.：按温度、载荷与转速推荐 ISO VG 等级: : by temperature, load and speed recommend an ISO VG grade
map.换油规范：为设备制定润滑油牌号与粘度标准: Change specification: set the oil grade and viscosity standard for equipment
map.工况校核：估算工作温度下的实际粘度是否足够: Duty check: estimate whether the actual viscosity at duty temperature is sufficient
map.算法：先按工况温度取基准粘度（<10℃ VG32、<40℃ VG46、<60℃: Algorithm: first by duty temperature take base viscosity (below 10 °C VG32, below 40 °C VG46, below 60 °C VG68, below 80 °C VG100, below 100 °C VG150, below 120 °C VG220, otherwise VG320); load factor light 0.8 / medium 1.0 / heavy 1.3; speed factor above 3000 rpm 0.7, above 1500 0.85, above 500 1.0, otherwise 1.2; computed viscosity = base times load factor times speed factor; among the ISO VG series [10, 22, 32, 46, 68, 100, 150, 220, 320, 460, 680] take the closest grade; duty viscosity = recommended VG times e^(-0.04 times (temperature minus 40)). Oil type: above 100 °C use full-synthetic (PAO / ester), above 70 °C use semi-synthetic or high-quality mineral, heavy load use EP extreme-pressure gear oil, otherwise mineral or semi-synthetic.
map.例：60℃、中载、1500rpm → 基准 VG100、载荷系数 1.0、转速系: Example: 60 °C, medium load, 1500 rpm gives base VG100, load factor 1.0, speed factor 1.00, computed viscosity 100 cSt, recommended VG100, duty viscosity about 44.9 cSt, recommended mineral or semi-synthetic oil. If 90 °C, heavy load, 400 rpm gives base VG150, load 1.3, speed 1.20, computed 234 cSt, take closest VG220, duty viscosity about 29.8 cSt, recommended semi-synthetic or high-quality mineral oil. If 30 °C, light load, 3500 rpm gives base VG46, load 0.8, speed 0.70, computed 26 cSt, recommended VG22, duty viscosity about 32.8 cSt.
map.为什么高速要选低粘度、低速重载选高粘度？: Why choose low viscosity at high speed and high viscosity at low speed heavy load?
map.高速时低粘度可减小搅油损失与发热、利于散热；低速重载时油膜容易被挤破，需要更高粘: At high speed low viscosity reduces churning loss and heat, aiding cooling; at low speed heavy load the oil film is easily squeezed out, needing higher viscosity to ensure film strength, and heavy load should use EP anti-wear additive gear oil.
map.工况粘度估算为什么随温度下降？: Why does the duty-viscosity estimate drop with temperature?
map.矿物油粘温关系近似指数，工具用 e^(−0.04×(T−40)) 折算：相对 4: Mineral-oil viscosity-temperature relation is roughly exponential; the tool uses e^(-0.04 times (T minus 40)): relative to the 40 °C baseline, every about 25 °C rise drops viscosity to about 37 percent. The key to selection is ensuring enough film thickness at duty temperature, so high-temperature duty needs a higher VG grade.
map.润滑油粘度选型工具根据工况温度、载荷等级和转速，综合计算所需的运动粘度，匹配最接: The lubricating oil viscosity selection tool, from duty temperature, load level and speed, comprehensively computes the required kinematic viscosity, matches the closest ISO VG viscosity grade, and recommends a suitable lubricant type (mineral / semi-synthetic / full-synthetic).
map.匹配 ISO VG 10~680 标准等级: Matches ISO VG 10 to 680 standard grades
map.估算工况下的实际运动粘度: Estimates actual kinematic viscosity at duty
